title: ERCOT HB_HUBAVG: day-ahead minus real-time by hour
subtitle: Mean spread for each local hour, 2026-09-27 to 2026-10-03, USD/MWh
source_line: Source: CAISO, ERCOT, MISO, SPP via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), tables iso_dam_hub_prices, iso_rtm_hub_prices; data retrieved to 2026-10-04.
citations: California Independent System Operator (CAISO). PRC_LMP: OASIS Locational Marginal Prices, day-ahead market (DAM). https://oasis.caiso.com/mrioasis/logon.do. Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT). NP4-190-CD: DAM Settlement Point Prices. https://www.ercot.com/mp/data-products/data-product-details?id=NP4-190-CD. Midcontinent Independent System Operator (MISO). da_expost_lmp: Day-Ahead Ex-Post LMP (daily csv) [PAUSED 2026-10-04: MISO's terms forbid automated access; pulls paused pending a review of MISO's terms by a person (docs/methods/miso_pause.md)]. https://www.misoenergy.org/markets-and-operations/real-time--market-data/market-reports/. Southwest Power Pool (SPP). DA-LMP-SL: Day-Ahead LMP by Settlement Location. https://portal.spp.org/pages/da-lmp-by-location. Retrieved 2026-10-04 via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table iso_dam_hub_prices, data commit 9c8cc9445771. Provenance tier: source (as the publisher published it, reshaped only).

Midcontinent Independent System Operator (MISO). rt_lmp_prelim: Real-Time Preliminary Ex-Post LMP, hourly (daily csv) [PAUSED 2026-10-04: MISO's terms forbid automated access; pulls paused pending a review of MISO's terms by a person (docs/methods/miso_pause.md)]. https://www.misoenergy.org/markets-and-operations/real-time--market-data/market-reports/. facts: ERCOT HB_HUBAVG, 2026-09-27 to 2026-10-03: the mean day-ahead minus real-time spread was highest in the hour starting 18:00 local, 15.62 USD/MWh, and lowest in the hour starting 10:00, -6.8 USD/MWh.
Mean spread over all hours, 2026-09-27 to 2026-10-03: -0.35 USD/MWh.
